summary: Completed comprehensive testing of new cinematic landing page at '/' with Hero, Demo, Features, Pricing, and CTA sections. All French UI elements working correctly. Login/dashboard flows functional. Minor authentication session persistence issue identified.

flaky_endpoints.issue: User authentication session expires quickly, causing inconsistent auth state
flaky_endpoints.symptoms: User gets logged out after short time, affecting redirect behavior from '/' to '/dashboard'
flaky_endpoints.workaround: Login persists during single session but may not survive page refreshes

integration_issues.issue: May not work consistently due to auth session persistence issue

passed_tests: Landing page loads at '/' for unauthenticated users (not login page)
Hero section renders with 'DORMEZ' headline and orbital animations
Navigation bar has correct French labels: Fonctionnalites, Comment ca marche, Tarifs, Connexion, Commencer
Demo section with Booking->Agent->Airbnb flow visualization displays
Features section with bento grid cards shows properly
Pricing section with 3 plans (Starter/Pro/Enterprise) renders correctly
CTA section at bottom of page displays
'Lancer la Mission' button navigates to /login successfully
After successful login, user redirects to /dashboard
Dashboard displays sidebar with all navigation links
Properties, Reservations, Console, Settings pages all accessible
Framer-motion scroll animations working on landing page
All French language content displays correctly
action_item_for_main_agent: Investigate authentication session persistence issue - tokens may be expiring too quickly or not being stored properly, which affects the logged-in user redirect from '/' to '/dashboard' functionality. Consider implementing longer session duration or better token refresh mechanism.
